purpose: y2s58: Nord2Metal only (built from y2s57-vt17's source + the fix). (1) a copied PLANE of a two-plane surface that a compute dispatch binds with ShaderWrite (VideoToolbox's Metal transfer writing into pixel buffers of 16-byte rows outside mediaserverd) is written back into the surface's plane after the command buffer completes (console: 'SURF writeback n=... bytes=...'); before, the output never reached the surface and the Photos grid thumbnails went black (run ph1, surface 157). (2) a whole two-plane surface asked for as format 540 for reading, which cannot be imported in place, is served converted to RGB by the CPU instead of nil ('no drawable'). (3) the 360-character shader dump lines of y2s57. The 16-byte alignment told to VideoToolbox outside mediaserverd is unchanged. Backup Nord2Metal.pre-vt18; undo: guest-vt18-undo.sh.
